0x0009B7.en: 「At my level now...@　this is as far as I go...!」

0x000A28.en: 「Gah!@　So this is where it ends...!!」

0x000AB0.en: 「Damn it!@　Next time you won't get me!」

0x000BD9.en: 「Is this as far as I go...!?」

0x000C11.en: 「Oh dear...@　how uncool of me, honestly!」

0x000D15.en: 「No way I'm failing here...!@　Not funny...」

0x000D69.en: 「I blew it...!@　No choice but to bail...」

0x000E53.en: 「This is as far as I go...!」

0x000EBA.en: 「So this is the end... I leave the rest to you.」

0x000F66.en: 「No good, I've taken too much damage... I'm pulling back!」

0x000FB3.en: 「Well, this is a bind. I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x000FF1.en: 「Kyaa! I'm counting on the rest of you!」

0x001038.en: 「To think the Granzon... would be shot down...」

0x0010E3.en: 「Ugh... So I'm the one who becomes a shooting star... Ejecting!」

0x00119A.en: 「Owowow... I give. A miscalculation on my part.」

0x00121F.en: 「Nn... ngh! So this is where it ends...!」

0x00128C.en: 「Ngh! All hands, abandon ship at once!!」

0x0012D3.en: 「I'm sorry, I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x001308.en: 「Damn it! So this is as far as my strength goes...!」

0x0013F4.en: 「To go down in a place like this...@　I'm still green...!」

0x001442.en: 「No good, I can't take any more! Retreating!」

0x0014BB.en: 「Sorry!@　I'm gonna have to bow out...!」

0x0014FD.en: 「Sorry, the rest is up to you!」

0x00152C.en: 「N-no good! This is as far as I go!!」

0x00156A.en: 「Well, well, so this is the end.」

0x001599.en: 「I can't do any more. If you'll excuse me.」

0x001624.en: 「Careless of me...@　I'll fall back for now...!」

0x00178A.en: 「Ejecting...@　Ngh...! Not exactly a graceful exit...」

0x001848.en: 「Gaah! Not in a place like this!!」

0x001A5A.en: 「No good, they went and got me.」

0x001B68.en: 「Commander, the Steel Dragon Squadron is nearing the Grand Christmas's final defense line. We need the order to sortie again, now...」

0x001C1F.en: 「Before that,@　we must ready the Air Christmas's trump card.」

0x001C72.en: 「Trump card...?@ You don't mean... the black box?」

0x001CC5.en: 「That's right... Let me show you the summary data.」

0x001D1E.en: 「The only Earth vessel currently mounting this system@　is this very Air Christmas.」

0x001DE1.en: 「A gift of the <EOT>.@　Though only a battleship-class hull can carry it.」

0x001E55.en: 「I'll now unseal the system.@ I'll decide when it's used, myself.@ Understood, Captain?」

0x001F36.en: 「Yes, sir. I'll stand by in the Galilnagant.」

0x001F6A.en: （...Why keep this system secret until now?@　If we'd used it in past operations...）

0x001FF3.en: 「Ngh! This ship holds TD altitude here!@　We'll cover our allied units!」

0x002049.en: 「Hugo,@　there's no sign of the Erde or the Air Christmas.」

0x00209F.en: 「They're here, no doubt about it. They'll show themselves.」

0x002117.en: 「Steel 2 to Mk-X.@　The BBC is ready.」

0x0021D0.en: 「Papa, whatever anyone says, I'm going to kill Ing.@　It's the perfect chance, after all.」

0x00223C.en: 「...Very well.@　Show Alteur the power of an Originator,@　the power of the new humanity.」

0x0022C3.en: 「But capture the Re-Tech machines intact@　where you can. Secure that system and its pilot@　as unharmed as possible.」

0x00235F.en: 「And the Melior Esse as well.@　They'll be a vital key in the Antarctic operation.」

0x002448.en: （Ing...@　Whatever designs lie behind your existence...@　I won't allow a mere copy to surpass me.）

0x0024E7.en: （I am the finest of the Machinery Children...@　I'll teach Alteur that much.）

0x00255E.en: （...If Ing falls to Egretta,@　then he was only ever that much...）

0x0025CC.en: （Let me see it, Ing.@　Whether you can become one of the chosen.）

0x002631.en: （If I can gain power that transcends humanity,@　and the Machinery Children too,@　I'll spare no sacrifice.）

0x00270C.en: 「We are the sword that guards Earth, the lords of a new world.@　The old humanity's sword shatters here.」

0x002795.en: 「Don't screw with me!@　Like hell we'd leave Earth to the likes of you!」

0x0027EE.en: 「Egretta Uno... return to where you belong.」

0x002837.en: 「Haha, you're treating me like I'm already dead.@　But you can't defeat me.@　That's already been proven.」

0x0028C7.en: 「You mean you keep coming back?@ That makes you a zombie.」

0x002914.en: 「Fragile lives, short lives...@　they can't protect Earth or keep it going.」

0x002976.en: 「Your existence is unstable...@　even if you hold great power now,@　you can't sustain it forever.」

0x002A1B.en: 「Human will and strength are passed down.@　They're never just a fleeting thing.」

0x002A80.en: 「But look back on human history.@　Isn't it more often passed down twisted and warped?」

0x002B03.en: 「In that, we're different. We hold our power and will unbroken.@ Yes, we Machinery Children@ are Earth's true guardians, the Gaia Sabers.」

0x002BD2.en: 「I... don't think so.@　Even if I'm a Machinery Child, same as you.」

0x002C40.en: 「Ing, you're of no more use.@　Papa said I'm free to kill you.」

0x002CBB.en: （All this time there was some purpose behind drawing out@　Ing's power, and now...@　is he saying that purpose is already fulfilled?）

0x002D75.en: 「The Gaia Sabers only need us@ Machinery Children to remain.@ We have no need of the Idealants.」

0x002E1A.en: 「Duvan realized that too, which is why he@　ran off. Though by now he's probably@　dying in a ditch somewhere.」

0x002EBF.en: 「We'll take over your role.@　Die here with an easy mind.」

0x002F2A.en: （Egretta... and Egret Feff.@　I came this far to learn the truth.）

0x002FAD.en: （If even that was all according to your plans...@　if my past denies who I am now, then...!）

0x00314F.en: 「Hehehe, this machine, just like the Ignite,@　is a reversible-transform unit.」

0x00320D.en: 「Yes.@　The TE Absorber prototype unit 10,@　MODEL-X...」

0x00326D.en: 「No, it's no longer a prototype.@　It carries the traits of both the Garmraid and the Cerberus,@　surpassing even the Blaze and the Ignite...」

0x00331B.en: 「One culmination of the Zentr Project.@ This Galvus, endowed with AI1 and Rasmnanium,@ is the ultimate humanoid mobile weapon.」

0x0033CF.en: 「For the sake of that thing, Aqua and I...@　Captain Albero...!」

0x003466.en: 「Now that this Galvus is complete,@ none of it matters. You too, Aqua.@ Both of you, vanish here together.」

0x003555.en: 「You foolish, ungrateful girl... and after all the things@　I've taught you over the years.」

0x0035FD.en: 「Erde Mitte...!@　You used us... no, not just Captain Albero, but@　Foglia too. Now you'll pay for it.」

0x0036A2.en: 「Used them? Come now...@　that man knew exactly what he was doing.@　Even if he only learned the truth at the very end.」

0x003732.en: 「And it all began with Dr. Zapad... no.@　He's dead now, so it hardly matters, does it?」

0x0037DB.en: 「Yes. He denied my AI1, so I killed him.」

0x00386F.en: 「Of course not.@　I simply stay true to my own curiosity.@　Anyone who stands in its way deserves to die.」

0x003912.en: 「Truly, a villainess so flawless it's almost admirable.」

0x003958.en: 「Oh? I did help avenge your Lieutenant Hugo,@　if you look at it a certain way.」

0x0039C0.en: 「That man is why the Cry Wolves were@　all but wiped out, after all...@　The Lieutenant ought to thank me.」

0x003A93.en: 「...Did you silence Mitarl?@　Or were you scheming to monopolize the project?」

0x003B0D.en: 「I told you before, didn't I? It's all for AI1. I want to see the world my child weaves with the Rathmunanium.」

0x003BA2.en: 「Go dream about it in a lab, then...!@　I'm done being dragged along@　by your delusions!」

0x003C3B.en: 「For Captain Albero, for Foglia, for all of them,@　I'll settle this here, with my own hands!!」

0x003C9D.en: 「Hffff... Come at Galvus with everything you have.@ The data I gather from this battle@ will nurture AI1's growth even further.」

0x003D6C.en: 「Yes... you'll offer everything to my child,@　and then you'll die.」
